title: Denmark – Printed matter and related products – Udbud af kontrakt vedrørende levering af biometriske adgangskort
description: Udlændingestyrelsen skal købe biometriske adgangskort til brug for registrering af en beboer på et udrejsecenters overholdelse af opholds- og/eller meldepligt. Adgangskortene skal indeholde beboerens fingeraftryk i krypteret form, og adgangskortene må kun kunne benyttes af beboeren, hvis biometri er optaget på adgangskortet. Kontrakten omfatter levering af de biometriske adgangskort, herunder stregkodekort, kortlæsere og kortudstedelsesudstyr, samt oplæring af medarbejdere i forbindelse med ibrugtagning af den tekniske løsning. Den udbudte kontrakt er ikke opdelt i delkontrakter, jf. udbudslovens § 49, stk. 2, da ordregiver ud fra kontraktgenstanden vurderer, at kontrakten ikke er egnet til opdeling, da der er tale om levering af biometriske adgangskort og stregkodekort til én adresse hos ordregiver.

title: Denmark – Business services: law, marketing, consulting, recruitment, printing and security – Kontrakt om kampagne for en respektfuld politisk debat og forebyggelse af chikane mod politikere
description: Folketinget, KL og Danske Regioner ønsker at udvikle og gennemføre en landsdækkende kampagne, der skal bidrage til en mere respektfuld politisk debat og forebygge chikane mod folkevalgte politikere. Kampagnen skal øge befolkningens forståelse af de demokratiske konsekvenser af chikane mod politikere og samtidig motivere flere borgere til aktivt at reagere, når de møder chikane eller en hadsk tone i den politiske debat. Den valgte leverandør skal udvikle kampagnestrategi, kreativt koncept, budskaber, visuel identitet, medieplan og kampagnematerialer samt stå for produktion, medieindrykning og gennemførelse af kampagnen. Kampagnen skal bygge på eksisterende forskning og målgruppeindsigter og udvikles i tæt samarbejde med Folketinget, KL og Danske Regioner. Opgaven omfatter desuden afprøvning af centrale kampagneelementer, løbende kvalitetssikring og strategiske anbefalinger til, hvordan kampagnen bedst kan skabe effekt og forankres over en flerårig periode. Kampagnen forventes gennemført som en landsdækkende indsats med mulighed for anvendelse på tværs af nationale, regionale og kommunale platforme. Det samlede budget for kampagnen er 2.500.000 DKK ekskl. moms.

title: Denmark – Legal advisory services – Udbud af rammeaftale om levering af juridiske tjenesteydelser i forbindelse med selskabsprojekter
description: Udbuddet har til formål at etablere en rammeaftale om levering af juridiske tjenesteydelser i forbindelse med statens selskabsprojekter. Ved Selskabsprojekter forstås selskabsretlige, transaktionsmæssige og/eller ejerrelaterede opgaver og relaterede projekter vedrørende selskaber, interessentskaber og offentlige virksomheder, herunder investeringer, køb og salg af virksomheder (M&A), kapitaludvidelser samt generelt rådgivning og bistand ved statens varetagelse af ejerskab i eksisterende selskaber, interessentskaber og offentlige virksomheder med statslig ejerandel eller interessentandel samt potentielt fremtidige nye selskaber, interessentskaber og offentlige virksomheder med statslig ejerandel eller interessentandel. Dette omfatter både minoritets- og majoritetsejede selskaber, statslige interessentandele samt børsnoterede selskaber. Rammeaftalen skal sikre adgang til juridisk rådgivning og bistand inden for følgende retsområder i forbindelse med et Selskabsprojekt: Primære retsområder: 1) selskabsret og corporate governance, 2) M&A, transaktioner og due diligence, 3)kapitalforhold og finansiering, 4)konkurrence- og fusionskontrolret, 5) kapitalmarkedsret og børsret, 6)kontraktret og kommercielle aftaler, 7) insolvens, rekonstruktion og nødlidende selskaber, Sekundære retsområder: 8) statsstøtteret, 9)skat, moms og afgifter, 10)tvister, ansvar og konfliktløsning, 11)FDI-screening 12)Executive lønpakker, herunder incitamentsordninger. Rammeaftalen tildeles op til 3 leverandører, og tildeling af konkrete rådgivningsopgaver sker ved miniudbud. Der indgås en rammeaftale med hver leverandør. Rammeaftalerne kan ud over Finansministeriet også anvendes af andre enheder i den danske stat. Den danske stat omfatter i denne sammenhæng ministerier, styrelser, direktorater, råd og nævn. Rammeaftalerne er ikke-eksklusiv. Kunden er ikke forpligtet til udelukkende at anvende de indgåede rammeaftaler og er således bl.a. berettiget til at benytte Kammeradvokataftalen samt selv at forestå udførelsen af ydelserne. Leverandørerne er ikke garanteret nogen minimumsomsætning.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Generalsanierung Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule Mühlacker, TWP
description: Die Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule in Mühlacker bereitet sich auf eine umfassende Neuausrichtung vor, um den Anforderungen der kommenden Jahrzehnte gerecht zu werden. Als zentraler Bildungs- und Lebensraum im Stadtteil Dürrmenz muss die Schule auf den tiefgreifenden Wandel in der Bildungslandschaft und veränderte ge-sellschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen reagieren. Ursprünglich als kombinierte Grund- und Hauptschule dimensio-niert, wird der Komplex heute als reine Grundschule geführt. Um den zukünftigen Anforderungen an eine zeit-gemäße Pädagogik, Chancengleichheit und die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf gerecht zu werden, soll der Standort planerisch vollständig neu konzipiert werden: Ziel ist die Entwicklung zu einer modernen, durchgehend vierzügigen Grundschule mit einem voll integrierten Ganztagsbetrieb. Dieser Schritt sichert langfristig eine hoch-wertige Lernumgebung und schafft die räumlichen Voraussetzungen für moderne, rhythmisierte Bildungsange-bote. Die Ulrich von Dürrmenz Schule in Mühlacker besteht aus einem heterogenen Gebäudekomplex, der zwei bau-lich völlig unterschiedliche Epochen vereint: dem historischen Altbau aus dem Jahr ca. 1885 und einem Erweite-rungsbau inklusive Zwischenbau aus dem Jahr 1968. Beide Gebäudeteile sind baulich, energetisch und technisch stark in die Jahre gekommen. Die Technische Gebäu-deausrüstung (TGA) sowie die Elektrotechnik (ELT) sind veraltet und durch punktuelle Teilsanierungen der ver-gangenen Jahrzehnte fragmentiert. Zudem weisen die Bestandsgebäude erhebliche Barrieren auf. Die starren Raumstrukturen entsprechen weder den Anforderungen an einen modernen, inklusiven Unterricht noch den logistischen Abläufen eines zeitgemä-ßen Schul- und Ganztagesbetriebs. Die bestehenden Freianlagen der Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule weisen derzeit nur eine eingeschränkte Nut-zungs- und Aufenthaltsqualität auf. Der Schulhof präsentiert sich überwiegend als große, zusammenhängende und asphaltierte Fläche mit geringem gestalterischem Differenzierungsgrad. Altersgerechte Spiel-, Bewegungs- und Aufenthaltsbereiche für die unterschiedlichen Nutzergruppen sind nur in begrenztem Umfang vorhanden. Die Ausstattung der Außenanlagen beschränkt sich im Wesentlichen auf einzelne Sitzbänke entlang der Randbe-reiche sowie die vorhandenen, überdachten Pausengänge im Bereich der Gebäudezugänge. Darüber hinaus be-stehen bauliche Mängel in den Freianlagen. Insbesondere die Außentreppe an der Nordseite ist infolge von Ge-ländesetzungen in ihrer Verkehrssicherheit beeinträchtigt und kann nicht mehr uneingeschränkt genutzt wer-den. Zur Verbesserung des Komforts sind darüber hinaus mehrere überdachte Unterstellmöglichkeiten mit inte-grierten Sitzgelegenheiten als Sonnen- und Regenschutz zu schaffen sein. Weitere Informationen entnehmen Sie der Maßnahmenbeschreibung des Verfahrensleitfadens.

title: Germany – Structural steelworks – Stahlbauarbeiten
description: TP C - Ausstellungsneuplanung und -erweiterung im Alten Turm der KWG Art und Umfang des Bauvorhabens Die Leitidee der Neugestaltung und Erweiterung der Ausstellung im Alten Turm ist die Reduktion der Bauelemente im Inneren zugunsten einer Verstärkung der bestehenden Atmosphäre. Das Hauptausstellungsobjekt ist dabei die Ruine des Alten Turms selbst. Statt neuer, dominierender architektonischer Eingriffe ist konzeptionell die Öffnung der nach Kriegsende hinzugekommenen und die Atmosphäre störenden Einbauten vorgesehen. Das skulpturale Denkmal soll zu einem begehbaren Mahnmal mit einer außergewöhnlichen räumlichen Licht- und Klanginszenierung weiterentwickelt werden, wobei der Ruinencharakter des Gebäudes betont wird. Die Inszenierung soll die Dramatik der Kriegsschäden "offen zeigen" und ein Erleben des Bauwerks durch die Elemente Licht, Wasser, Wind und Klang ermöglichen. Zweck und Notwendigkeit der Baumaßnahmen sind die nachhaltige Sicherung, sowie die Verbesserung der nationalen und internationalen Wahrnehmbarkeit der historischen und gegenwärtigen Bedeutung des denkmalgeschützten Ensembles.

title: Germany – Screed works – PW8 VE325.1 Estrich Gussasphalt

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Generalsanierung Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule Mühlacker, TWP
description: Die Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule in Mühlacker bereitet sich auf eine umfassende Neuausrichtung vor, um den Anforderungen der kommenden Jahrzehnte gerecht zu werden. Als zentraler Bildungs- und Lebensraum im Stadtteil Dürrmenz muss die Schule auf den tiefgreifenden Wandel in der Bildungslandschaft und veränderte ge-sellschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen reagieren. Ursprünglich als kombinierte Grund- und Hauptschule dimensio-niert, wird der Komplex heute als reine Grundschule geführt. Um den zukünftigen Anforderungen an eine zeit-gemäße Pädagogik, Chancengleichheit und die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf gerecht zu werden, soll der Standort planerisch vollständig neu konzipiert werden: Ziel ist die Entwicklung zu einer modernen, durchgehend vierzügigen Grundschule mit einem voll integrierten Ganztagsbetrieb. Dieser Schritt sichert langfristig eine hoch-wertige Lernumgebung und schafft die räumlichen Voraussetzungen für moderne, rhythmisierte Bildungsange-bote. Die Ulrich von Dürrmenz Schule in Mühlacker besteht aus einem heterogenen Gebäudekomplex, der zwei bau-lich völlig unterschiedliche Epochen vereint: dem historischen Altbau aus dem Jahr ca. 1885 und einem Erweite-rungsbau inklusive Zwischenbau aus dem Jahr 1968. Beide Gebäudeteile sind baulich, energetisch und technisch stark in die Jahre gekommen. Die Technische Gebäu-deausrüstung (TGA) sowie die Elektrotechnik (ELT) sind veraltet und durch punktuelle Teilsanierungen der ver-gangenen Jahrzehnte fragmentiert. Zudem weisen die Bestandsgebäude erhebliche Barrieren auf. Die starren Raumstrukturen entsprechen weder den Anforderungen an einen modernen, inklusiven Unterricht noch den logistischen Abläufen eines zeitgemä-ßen Schul- und Ganztagesbetriebs. Die bestehenden Freianlagen der Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule weisen derzeit nur eine eingeschränkte Nut-zungs- und Aufenthaltsqualität auf. Der Schulhof präsentiert sich überwiegend als große, zusammenhängende und asphaltierte Fläche mit geringem gestalterischem Differenzierungsgrad. Altersgerechte Spiel-, Bewegungs- und Aufenthaltsbereiche für die unterschiedlichen Nutzergruppen sind nur in begrenztem Umfang vorhanden. Die Ausstattung der Außenanlagen beschränkt sich im Wesentlichen auf einzelne Sitzbänke entlang der Randbe-reiche sowie die vorhandenen, überdachten Pausengänge im Bereich der Gebäudezugänge. Darüber hinaus be-stehen bauliche Mängel in den Freianlagen. Insbesondere die Außentreppe an der Nordseite ist infolge von Ge-ländesetzungen in ihrer Verkehrssicherheit beeinträchtigt und kann nicht mehr uneingeschränkt genutzt wer-den. Zur Verbesserung des Komforts sind darüber hinaus mehrere überdachte Unterstellmöglichkeiten mit inte-grierten Sitzgelegenheiten als Sonnen- und Regenschutz zu schaffen sein. Weitere Informationen entnehmen Sie der Maßnahmenbeschreibung des Verfahrensleitfadens.

title: Germany – Construction work – Umbau, Sanierung und Erweiterung Grundschule am Harrl - Zimmererarbeiten Phase 4
description: Das Schulgebäude ist ein ca. 1876 erbauter historischer Massivbau, unterkellert und 4- geschossig. Das Schulgebäude ist als Baudenkmal nach § 3 Abs. 2 NDSchG eingestuft. Das Hauptgebäude enthält die Unterrichts-, Gruppen- und Differenzierungsräume, die Verwaltung, Mehrzweckräume sowie Nebenräume. Im UG befindet sich neben Lager- und Technikräumen ein Werkraum sowie eine Lehrküche, diese Nutzungen sollen im Zuge des Umbaus ertüchtigt werden. In der Phase 1 wurde ein drittes Treppenhaus über alle Geschosse und ein Mensaneubau (mit Musikräumen im 2.OG) errichtet. In der Phase 2 wurde das 3.OG (ehemalige Hausmeisterwohnung und der nicht genutzte Dachboden) zu Schulräumen umgenutzt und eine Lüftungsanlage im Dachboden eingebaut. Die Sanierung der Sanitärkerne mit Erstellung von neuen Steigesträngen erfolgte ebenfalls in Phase 2. Die Sanitärkerne und das 2.OG (Phase 3) sind derzeit noch Baustellenbereich. Ursprünglich sollte das Schulgebäude im laufenden Betrieb in den nächsten Jahren abschnittsweise saniert, umgebaut und erweitert werden. Damit die restlichen Geschosse unabhängig vom Schulbetrieb fertiggestellt werden können, wird der komplette Schulbetrieb ausgelagert. Voraussichtlich kann nach den Herbstferien 2026 die restliche Sanierung starten. In diesem Bauabschnitt (Phase 4) soll das 1. OG/ EG und der Rest des Kellergeschosses in einem Zuge saniert werden. Hinweis: Bei allen Abbrucharbeiten sind Feuerlöscher in unmittelbarer Nähe bereitzuhalten.

description: International Media Support (IMS) seeks to establish a pool of qualified research providers through framework agreements to deliver recurring audience segmentation studies and related audience intelligence services across Eastern Europe and the Western Balkans. IMS reserves the right to enter into more than one framework agreement as a result of this tender. Across the region, disinformation, information manipulation, and declining trust in information sources continue to affect public discourse and democratic resilience. To design effective responses, media organisations, civil society actors, and other stakeholders require a deeper understanding of audience behaviours, information needs, media consumption habits, levels of trust, and vulnerability to harmful narratives. Through this tender, IMS aims to identify service providers capable of designing and implementing audience segmentation studies and related research in multiple countries across Eastern Europe and the Western Balkans. The findings will support IMS and its partners in developing evidence-based strategies, content, engagement approaches, and interventions that strengthen information integrity and more effectively reach priority audiences. Applications are welcome from research companies, consultancies, academic institutions, and consortia with the required expertise and capacity to deliver high-quality audience research services across the target regions.

title: Low Profile Mast and Rotational Module Component Prototype Other Transaction Area of Interest
description: *9.23.2026: Updated Attachment 1: TOU to correct the listed PCO within the document. Team Submarines, Australia, United Kingdom, and United States (AUKUS), International & Systems (AI&S), Submarine Electromagnetic Systems Program Office (PMS 435) is pleased to release a competitive Area of Interest (AOI) announcement for the Low Profile Mast (LPM) and Rotational Module (RM) component to address several key operational needs. The LPM/RM programs seek innovative technologies that accelerate the prototyping of capabilities that address these key operational needs. To accelerate the design, development and demonstration of LPM/RM capabilities, the Navy will be utilizing the Other Transaction Authority pathway outlined in Title 10 U.S.C. � 4022. It is intended that this solicitation may result in the award of one or more prototype projects. There are nine (9) attachments to this AOI, some of which contain Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI): LPM/RM Terms of Use Agreement AOI AOI Guidance CUI LPM Type 24 Mod 1Top-Level Requirements Document [RESTRICTED] CUI LPM Verification Guide (VG) [RESTRICTED] CUI RM Top-Level Requirements Document [RESTRICTED] CUI RM Verification Guide [RESTRICTED] LPM/RM AOI Questions Form CUI LPM/RM Placemat Template [RESTRICTED] Companies are advised to proceed with the following steps to respond to this notice: STEP 1 � Terms of Use Agreement (TOU) Several key documents related to the LPM Type 24 Mod 1 and RM are only releasable to eligible businesses with ownership in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia. Non-Australia, United Kingdom, or United States foreign-owned businesses may submit a technical solution as part of a teaming arrangement with one or more Australia, United Kingdom, or United States-owned businesses. The ability to be awarded an Agreement may depend upon the ability of the Foreign-owned business to obtain necessary clearances and approvals to obtain access to restricted information. Companies interested in submitting a technical solution in response to the AOI shall complete Attachment 1: TOU Agreement and return it via e-mail to the Agreements Officer and Agreements Specialists listed in this notice. The Company point of contact that will request access to the restricted documents in this notice shall be the Company point of contact listed in the TOU. Companies should also request access to the restricted CUI documents in SAM at the time of TOU submittal to the Government. Once the signed TOU is received and verified, Team Submarines will grant access to the restricted CUI documents and transmit relevant UNCLASSIFIED Government-Furnished Information (GFI) to the Company point of contact listed in the TOU. title: Sources Sought Notice for Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories SEL-2741
description: Notice of intent to use a brand name product. The Department of Navy, Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC), Pacific is conducting market research in accordance with FAR Part 10 to identify potential manufacturers capable of producing ruggedized, switchgear mounted, ethernet switches that have equal performance and listing/approval requirements as the SEL-2741 that is manufactured by Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories. Responses from third-party distributors, pass through resellers, or supply brokers who do not directly own the production line or manufacturing rights to a qualified equivalent product will not be considered responsive to this market survey. Fiscal Year 2027 SIOP PROJECT P-8026 ELECTRICAL BACKBONE located at Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard and IMF Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, Hawaii, requires that the ruggedized, switchgear mounted, ethernet switches demonstrate the following salient characteristics: Industrial Ethernet Communications � Provide a managed industrial Ethernet switch to support reliable communications between protective relays, automation controllers, SCADA systems, meters, and other intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) within the substation network. Network Management and Security � Support managed network functions including virtual local area networks (VLANs), Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (RSTP), port monitoring, traffic prioritization, Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP), and user authentication to ensure secure, resilient, and maintainable communications infrastructure. Time Synchronization � Support Precision Time Protocol (PTP) transparent clock functionality, Network Time Protocol (NTP), and other time synchronization methods to provide accurate event time-stamping and coordination of protection and automation devices. Network Monitoring � Continuously monitor switch status, communications links, network performance, and diagnostic information. Generate alarms and event logs for communication failures, port status changes, and network faults to support system maintenance and troubleshooting. Substation Integration � Support integration with substation automation and SCADA systems through industry-standard Ethernet networking technologies and protocols, providing reliable communications for protection, control, monitoring, engineering access, and system diagnostics. This is not a request for proposals, quotes, or an invitation for bid. The intent of this notice is to identify potential alternative ruggedized, switchgear mounted, ethernet switches that will satisfy agency requirements. To be considered, please submit detailed technical data in order for the Government to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of your product to ensure compatibility with the existing system. In accordance with FAR 15.101(c)(2), a response to this notice is not an offer and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The responder is solely responsible for the information it submits and any associated costs. The Government reserves the right to disregard any submittal that is incomplete or vague. Please do not submit company brochures. Please submit complete information via email to Ms. Michelle Gopwani-Lee via electronic mail at michelle.m.gopwani-lee.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 20 October 2026 at 12:00 p.m. H.S.T. Information received after the due date/time will not be considered. Any information provided to the Government in response to this RFI will become U.S. Government property and will not be returned. All proprietary or classified information will be treated appropriately.

description: This is a Sources Sought announcement in accordance with RFO FAR 15.101(e) and in anticipation of a potential future procurement program. Southwest Regional Maintenance Center (SWRMC) is conducting market research to determine industry capability and interest in performing the Preservation, Hull, Mechanical, and Electrical/Electronic Repairs for USS GREEN BAY (LPD-20) Boats: 7MRBX0502, 7MRB0503, 11MRX1401, and 11MRX0504. This is not a request for proposal (RFP) and a formal solicitation is not available at this time. This notice does not constitute a commitment by the Government to issue an RFP, contract, or order. The Government will not pay for any effort expended or any material provided in response to this announcement, nor will the Government return any data provided. Southwest Regional Maintenance Center (SWRMC) is seeking small business concerns within San Diego County . The prospective contractor will need to accomplish the Preservation, Hull, Mechanical, and Electrical/Electronic Repairs for the USS GREEN BAYs Trailerable Boats - 7MRBX0502, 7MRB0503, 11MRX1401, and 11MRX0504. The work will be accomplished at Contractors facility which shall be within 50 miles of 32nd Street Naval Base San Diego. The contemplated period of performance (POP) is from 25 JAN 2027 to 21 DEC 2027.The applicable NAICS is 336611 Ship Building and Repairing. Interested vendors should submit a capabilities statement (not to exceed five pages) that demonstrates their capability to perform the services described herein. The capabilities statement shall include:--Company name--Address--Business size (large, small, 8(a) small business, women-owned small business, HUBZone small business, veteran-owned small business, or service-disabled veteran-owned small business)[more than one category may be selected as applicable]--Point of contact (POC) information for the interested firm--Companys technical capabilities.The capabilities statement should also identify, by contract number, past or current contracts and/or subcontracts that were awarded to your firm, period of performance, contract type, contract amount, a description of the relevant corporate experience gained, and a point of contact for the customer/recipient of the work performed. The vendor shall describe if they have experience performing similar repair requirements and if they can accomplish at least 51 percent of the work in the specification package in-house. The vendor shall also indicate if they plan to accomplish work on the subject USS GREEN BAYs Trailerable Boats at their facility located within 50 miles of 32nd Street Naval Base San Diego.The Government will evaluate each respondents capabilities statement to determine if the respondent has the requisite technical capabilities, and experience to complete the requirements described herein. No telephone inquiries will be accepted. The Government does not commit to providing a response to any comments or questions. No basis for a claim against the Government shall arise as a result of this announcement. Responses should be received no later than 20 October 2026.All responses should be forwarded to Ms. Natalie Arenz, Ms. Kristin Liljestrom and Mr. Roderick Rioveros, at: 410B_RFP_27R0005_GBY_RHIBs@us.navy.mil.

title: USDA Forest Service Cultural Resource Evaluation and Documentation
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1284LM27Q0001 is issued as a Request for Quotes. The Sand Creek Road Cultural Site Evaluation project is evaluation of 25 previously identified cultural sites along approximately 6 miles of road located in McKenzie County on the McKenzie Ranger District of the Dakota Prairie Grasslands. The USFS is requesting that 25 unevaluated sites within a 50 ft ROW of Sand Creek Road (McKenzie County Road 2) have evaluative testing. A list of these sites is provided in Table 1 of the Performance Work Statement. The testing will be done in two phases. The intent of this contract is phase one. Phase one is shovel testing to determine the presence or absence of buried cultural material. Phase two will be formal testing to determine if found cultural deposits represent intact cultural components will be done at a later time and is not part of this contract. Many of the cairn sites have lithic materials found at these locations. The presence of lithic materials suggests that there may be evidence of open camp activities. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 541620. The small business size standard is $19M. This acquisition is a total small business set-aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. Please see the attached documents for specific requirements and submittal instructions. Questions should be emailed to joanne.meiers@usda.gov no later than 10/15/26.

title: Notice of Intent to Award Sole Source
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD SOLE SOURCE Project Title: PMW 410 Maritime Integrated Broadcast Service (MIBS) Joint Tactical Terminal-Maritime Evolved (JTT-ME) Solicitation Number: N6175027R0001 The Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWAR), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Mission Systems (MS) Naval Intelligence, IW, Communications, and Sensing (NI2CS) Portfolio, Battlespace Awareness and Information Operations (BAIO) Program Management Warfare Office (PMW) 410, intends to award a follow-on sole-source contract to L3Harris Technologies, Inc. (L3Harris) located in San Diego, CA. The contract will be for the production, delivery, and sustainment of the Embedded National Tactical Receiver Version Four (ENTR V4) receivers and Multiplexers, spares, repair units, and obsolescent part repairs to satisfy Maritime Integrated Broadcast Service (MIBS) Joint Tactical Terminal-Maritime Evolved (JTT-ME) requirements. The Government anticipates a hybrid Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) and Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract with a five-year base period and five one-year option periods. The Maritime Integrated Broadcast Service (MIBS) program delivers the Integrated Broadcast Service (IBS) capability to the fleet, providing critical tactical data and situational awareness to Combatant Commanders. The ENTR V4 and the associated Multiplexer are key hardware components that are integrated tactical components that must be procured together to ensure interoperability. The Navy requires continued production and lifecycle sustainment of the ENTR V4 receiver and Multiplexer. As the original developer, L3Harris exclusively owns the proprietary technical data and designs and maintains the required security certifications and secure manufacturing capabilities for tactical equipment. Development by any other source would result in substantial, non-recoverable duplication of engineering and testing costs that the Government cannot expect to recover through competition. L3Harris is the only vendor capable of meeting all technical, security, and delivery requirements without unacceptable delay or substantial duplication of cost. The authority permitting other than full and open competition is 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.103-1(c)(2)(i) and (ii), Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals or a solicitation of offers. Responses to this notice of intent to award to L3Harris shall be submitted no later than fifteen (15) calendar days from the date of this synopsis to Christopher Auen at christopher.d.auen.civ@us.navy.mil. As part of a response, a responsible source may submit a capability statement explaining how it is qualified to meet the Government�s requirements described above. Responses received later than fifteen (15) calendar days from the date of publication of this synopsis will be late and will not be considered.

title: IT, Lab, and Furniture Equipment
description: Sources Sought: IT, Lab, and Furniture Equipment This Sources Sought is part of the U.S. Government's market research efforts to identify capable vendors to provide: IT Equipment, Lab Equipment, and Furniture. The information gathered will help inform future procurement strategies and requirements, including whether to structure future solicitation(s) as a single combined RFQ or as separate group-specific awards. This Sources Sought is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a Request for Quotation (RFQ), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or Request for Proposal (RFP), nor a promise to issue one in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service. The U.S. Government is not seeking quotes, bids, or proposals at this time and will not accept unsolicited proposals in response to this notice. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. Submittals will not be returned to the responder. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future RFQ, IFB, or RFP, if any is issued. The requirement is organized into three groups, each governed by its own draft Statement of Work (SOW): Group 1 � IT Equipment: Digital exploitation hardware and software, including forensic workstations, servers, network equipment, cameras, and forensic software licenses for CBP-CAMDEX, FBI-TEDAC1 and FBI-TEDAC2 (see draft SOW � IT Equipment). Note: The Government is concurrently evaluating this requirement against the NASA SEWP contract vehicle. This RFI serves as a contingency market research effort should procurement through NASA SEWP not be feasible. Group 1 will not be combined with Group 2 or Group 3 in any future solicitation. Group 2 � Lab Equipment: Specialized digital exploitation lab equipment, including soldering/rework stations, microscopes, ESD-safe tools and supplies, and related consumables for CBP-CAMDEX, FBI-TEDAC1 and FBI-TEDAC2 (see draft SOW � Lab Equipment). Group 3 � Furniture: Specialized lab furniture, including ESD-safe workbenches, chairs, drawers, and workstation components for CBP-CAMDEX and FBI-TEDAC1 (see draft SOW � Furniture). The Government contemplates issuance of separate RFQ(s) as follows: (a) a standalone RFQ for Group 1 (IT Equipment), issued only if required as a contingency to the NASA SEWP procurement path; and (b) an RFQ permitting firms to quote on Group 2, Group 3, or both, with firms quoting on a given group required to provide all equipment types within that group. Group 1 will not be combined with Group 2 or Group 3 under any circumstances. Responding to this Sources Sought Responses are limited to no more than 20 pages in length, using 14-point font. The Government prefers responses in Microsoft Word, Adobe Acrobat, or a combination of both; documents must be searchable. If responding to Group 1, please also indicate whether your company holds a NASA SEWP contract vehicle position, as the Government is evaluating that path as its primary procurement route for this group. Can your company meet these terms without modification, substitution, or exception? Does your company have an existing local partner or representative in Mexico to fulfill in-country warranty claims? Delivery to Brownsville, TX: Can your company meet the 60-calendar-day delivery timeline to the Brownsville, TX receiving location for your proposed group(s)? Please describe estimated lead times and any anticipated logistical risks, including for items requiring special handling (e.g., forensic software licenses, ESD-sensitive lab equipment, or furniture requiring assembly). Please address estimated cost, lead time (including customs clearance time, if applicable to Option (b)), and any logistical risks associated with each option for your proposed group(s). For Option (b), please confirm whether your company can meet the 60-calendar-day delivery timeline; if not, please propose an alternative timeline. Please note: for Option (b), USG will not provide documentation, letters, or other support to facilitate export, import, or customs clearance; all such requirements would be the vendor's sole responsibility. If your company can only support Option (a), please state so. This will not affect the evaluation of your Brownsville, TX delivery capability. Software License Delivery & Activation (IT Group only): For forensic and exploitation software licenses (e.g., FTK, Cellebrite, MSAB, Magnet Axiom), can your company provide secure electronic delivery, along with written installation instructions and technical support during end-user activation? Please describe your process for coordinating license registration with a government point of contact. Sourcing and Distribution: Is your company an authorized distributor/reseller for the manufacturers specified across the three groups?
